text: I've come to the conclusion that in order for a man to even enter my life in any capacity, like even as a friend, you will have to genuinely get on your knees and start barking. If not, I don't want to hear it. I genuinely, and I'm not saying people are like dying to talk to me, like men are not dying to talk to me, but if you are even thinking about it, get on the floor, get on the floor, get on your knees, bark, bark. If you're not going to do that, shut up and get with me. Imagine being so delusional that you think the entry fee to your life is a man getting on his knees and barking, not metaphorically, literally, like you are running a circus audition instead of trying to build a relationship. Any test from a woman that starts with you degrading yourself is not just a red flag, it's a huge red billboard. If a woman tries to see how far can I push him, how much can I embarrass him, how much of my chaos will he tolerate, you don't play these games. Because if you pass those tests by complying, you don't gain respect, you lose it. The second you get on the floor and bark, you are not a man in her eyes anymore, or in the eyes of many other people for that matter. So once again, if her filter for male attention involves you humiliating yourself, there is nothing to work on, nothing to talk through, nothing to prove. You don't argue, you don't negotiate, you don't show you are secure enough to accept this respect, you stand up, keep your dignity and let her find someone else to bark for her.
